# 854. K-Similar Strings

## Solution 1

```python
# BFS
class Solution(object):
    def kSimilarity(self, s1, s2):
        """
        :type s1: str
        :type s2: str
        :rtype: int
        """
        step, n = 0, len(s1)
        q, vis = [(s1, 0)], set([s1])
        while True:
            new_q = []
            for s, i in q:
                if s == s2:
                    return step
                while i < n and s[i] == s2[i]:
                    i += 1
                for j in range(i + 1, n):
                    if s[j] == s2[i]:
                        t = list(s)
                        t[i], t[j] = t[j], t[i]
                        t = "".join(t)
                        if t not in vis:
                            vis.add(t)
                            new_q.append((t, i + 1))
            q = new_q
            step += 1
```
